purpose: Retrospective matched-protocol supplement requested for thesis writing; not a replacement for the closed prospective confirmation
training: Fresh seeded initialization for every arm. Reuse frozen 39-feature input ordering, fit-only scaler, client ownership, LayerNorm MLP, dropout zero, fixed-denominator sqrt-weighted CE, batch size 500 and full participation of 20 clients.
settings_rationale: Adam/MIME rates are the historical development-selected rates. FedProx uses the matched FedAvg rate and BOTH previously tried coefficients, not a newly selected winner. SCAFFOLD and its SGD controls use the previously tried SGD rate 0.01. No new hyperparameter search or best-epoch selection.
scaffold: Plain SGD, no momentum/weight decay/clipping, weighted Option II controls; weighted model and control averaging using the existing Flower aggregation helper
fedprox: Reset client Adam with the analytic gradient mu*(local-global) of mu/2 times squared parameter distance; include biases and normalization parameters, no extra data backward pass
mime: Existing full-MIME lagged-v base updater, 24 rounds; charge all full anchors and both local gradients. Its central base is a separate control, not ordinary Adam.
compression: Existing 4-bit block128 bidirectional residual-feedback codec; score delivered client model
fairness: Equal backward-example exposure, same fit objective and architecture. Not equal FLOPs, elapsed time, optimizer calls or communication. Federated methods without anchors share sampled client row streams; MIME has additional anchors and fewer local blocks within its budget. Central controls sample pooled rows.
calibration: Reuse original grouped development calibration mask. Fit thresholds on calibration benign rows only, save all endpoints and thresholds before opening confirmation for scoring.
evaluation: Report full-development argmax, development-audit argmax and calibrated scores, and previously evaluated confirmation argmax and frozen-threshold scores for ALL arms/seeds. Do not reopen original validation/test splits.
interpretation: The named confirmation cohort is already exposed. This supplement is retrospective, not a new untouched holdout, optimizer search, convergence proof or proof of algorithm superiority.
